Mira Chen: Heads-up: drafting a long-term platform roadmap doc for routing policies, multi-region, and multi-tenant isolation. Need product + eng alignment on launch criteria and priority customers.
Jordan Patel: Include cost/latency tradeoffs and pricing anchors.
Alex Rivera: Require concrete cross-region failover constraints and a safe default routing policy.
Samir Gupta: Add model-compatibility matrix (quantized vs fp16) and deterministic fallback ordering.
Priya Nair: Top customer asks: region pinning, SLA-backed latency, isolation lanes.
Mira Chen: Proposed launch criteria: policy templates, per-tenant telemetry, rollback + automated fallback.
Jordan Patel: Acceptance tests: synthetic latency + 2 pilot Dedicated customers.
Alex Rivera: Ops constraints: autoscaler interactions, burst SLOs, noisy-neighbor guardrails.
Samir Gupta: Define hard isolation (no cross-tenant routing/cache) vs affinity-optimized (best-effort).
Priya Nair: Sales needs a delivery timeline and justification for isolation pricing.
Mira Chen: Action items: I'll open PR with templates. @Jordan draft tests; @Alex/@Samir add ops/gating SLAs; @Priya collect enterprise asks.
